stem:
Ocean water absorbs carbon dioxide from the atmosphere. Carbon dioxide lowers the pH of the ocean water, which is harmful to organisms living in the ocean.

Which activity is most likely to decrease the amount of carbon dioxide being added to the ocean water?

options.label: A
options.text: Cutting down rain forests to use the land to farm crops

options.label: B
options.text: Constructing homes on farmland rather than on vacant lots in cities

options.label: C
options.text: Going to school in cars instead of riding the bus with other students

options.label: D
options.text: Using electrically powered devices instead of those powered by fossil fuels
